messages:
Maya (CSM): Heads-up — Polaris dedicated bring-up TOMORROW 09:00 PT. Need final quota gating, autoscale knobs, and a short smoke plan. Who can own post-deploy load test and SLA watch? cc @Devon @Luke
Luke (SRE): I can own load tests + failover checks. Plan: 30m gradual ramp to 200 qps, then a 5m spike to 1k. Will need target slot count, min warm replicas, and access to the dedicated pool quotas.
Devon (Oncall): I’ll watch latency SLOs and infra health during the ramp. What’s the expected steady-state RPS and 95p latency target from CS?
Maya (CSM): Polaris says steady qps=180, 95p latency <120ms, allowed bursts to 1k for 5m. Renewal is on the line — we need a clean run. Also we have enablement with their infra team at 11:00 PT after the deploy.
Anika (PM): For autoscale policy suggestion: min_replicas: 2, max_replicas: 40, scale_window: 60s, cpu_threshold: 65%, scale_up_multiplier: 3.0. Posting snippet below for ops to review.
Anika (PM): ```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 40
  scale_window_s: 60
  cpu_threshold_pct: 65
  scale_up_multiplier: 3.0
  cool_down_s: 90
```
Luke (SRE): We'll also configure a conservative cooldown on the scheduler to avoid flapping. Suggest burst_policy: allow_spiky=true, fallback_model: hosted-lite.
Maya (CSM): Quota ask: carve 3200 tokens/s to the dedicated pool for Polaris initial window, with a soft fallback to shared if we hit limits. Ops, can we get that provisioned by 07:30 PT?
Luke (SRE): Ops noted. I'll request quota with infra now. Also adding a pre-warm step: send warm prefixes for top-10 intents ~15 min before traffic starts.
Luke (SRE): Sample load command (internal rload tool):
```bash
rload run --target=https://dedicated.redwood/polaris --profile=polaris-gradual.json --duration=00:40:00 --ramp=00:30:00 --max-reqs=1000
```
Devon (Oncall): ops-bot, please create a temporary channel for go-live chatter and alert routing.
ops-bot: Created channel #polaris-go-live-1745129999 and added Maya, Luke, Devon, Anika.
Maya (CSM): Quick go-live checklist: 1) quota carved 2) autoscale applied 3) warm prefixes primed 4) smoke test pass (<5 failed requests) 5) enablement session done 6) rollback plan validated 7) post-run notes template ready.
Anika (PM): I uploaded the load profiles and customer acceptance criteria to the runbook doc. Link: https://internal.redwood/docs/polaris/bringup (internal).
Devon (Oncall): I'll be on call 08:50–10:30 PT. If 95p > 200ms for 3 consecutive minutes -> cut traffic to hosted fallback and throttle.
Luke (SRE): A couple of quick probes to validate: node-drain on one replica, quick KV cache warm hit-rate check, and model-variant fallback test. Will run those during the 20m pre-window.
Maya (CSM): I'll ping Polaris at 08:40 PT for final go/no-go. Please be in #polaris-go-live-1745129999 by 08:50. Anything missing?
Anika (PM): I'll lead the post-mortem template and capture feedback about training material for their engineers — especially around autoscale tuning.
Luke (SRE): ACK.
Devon (Oncall): ACK.
Maya (CSM): :thumbsup: Thanks team — this go-live is high priority for the renewal.
